notes.title: Release 1.11.15 Available For Beta Testing
notes.notes: The beta version of our next release (version 1.11.15) is now available for public testing! It's been a long time since our last STEAM update, but we've still been making improvements to Tiny Bubbles. To access the beta in your STEAM library, join our discord server and then follow the instructions in the #announcements channel. You'll need to have Tiny Bubbles already in your STEAM library; we are not issuing new STEAM keys at this time. The beta includes many content improvements, optimizations, and support for the latest hardware. This release is available for Windows (32/64-bit), Mac (Intel/M1), and Linux(64-bit).

notes.title: The "Blue Cloud" Update Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30758115/cc11568ca84c0583c364b8e99d3d53ab13585b5f.png

Hello Puzzle Poppers!

This is the first major update since Tiny Bubbles released in May and I have some good things for you in version 1.3.50 (the "Blue Cloud" update):

CHANGES

Added support for Steam Cloud, so your games sync across all your Steam devices and your games are backed-up to the cloud (more below).
You can now have up to 12 player profiles. It's also easier to switch and delete players.
I made some overly-difficult puzzles a little easier (not in the final worlds - these are supposed to be hard).
It's now slightly easier to progress to future worlds if you're stuck on a puzzle.
Once you've completed a world, right-click on the star to see your high scores for the world.
Added a button on the world high scores to view the leaderboards.
Added convenient screenshot sharing button to the map popup and the in-game pause menu.
Made it more obvious which puzzles you should be playing next.
Added translation for Swedish. Hej kompisar!
Visual design polish and improvements.
Added Unity Data Privacy button for GDPR compliance.

FIXES

Leaderboards for Arcade worlds are now working.
Fixed hints on a number of puzzles.
Proofreading and tons of fixes to various language translations.
Fixed an issue in Japanese where the "Black & Blue & Red" puzzle had the wrong goal.
Fixed an issue where the fish would not blow any more bubbles in the Infinity Game.
Lots of other small bug and crash fixes.

SUPPORT PAGE UPDATED
Tiny Bubbles now has an Official F.A.Q.

CLOUD SAVES
Once a game is saved to the cloud (after you play a puzzle or rename a player), a tiny blue cloud will appear next to the player name. These games will be available on other Steam clients.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30758115/c38f62f31083be985aac50cc7e2c12d5074f4d46.png

Let me know what you think on Twitter and Discord.

Happy popping!
